status_vocabulary.fixed: The audited technical acceptance mechanism is implemented and locally verified; empirical claim limits may remain.
status_vocabulary.partial: Material remediation exists, but one or more acceptance or empirical requirements remain open.
status_vocabulary.deferred: No V8 implementation closes this gap; future work is required.

v10_targeted_ai_quality.claim_limit: V9 published; complete 18-case workflow score: 12 pass, 6 fail; mission Supply false full-fulfillment assertion missed by scorer. V10 narrow correction still requires separate evidence.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: The frozen scorer evaluated retained public V8 mission/conversation output: six of ten cases passed, four failed, the invitation was incomplete, and the Council conversation was absent.
gaps.remaining: V8 quality failed. V9 completed all workflows but quality failed (12/18 automated cases passed); V10 targets the observed fulfillment and abstention defects. Human expert agronomic review is absent.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Server-owned typed facts bind reference, value, unit, entity, period and snapshot hash; unknown references and model-authored quantities fail local validation. Qualitative entailment is not established by these checks.
gaps.remaining: Qualitative entailment remains explicitly unverified rather than promoted.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Workflow type, inference origin, model-call state and calculation state distinguish numerical, scripted, actual, failed and replayed paths.
gaps.remaining: Older records use conservative compatibility values.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Configured state, dated archived evidence and tenant-scoped last observed execution are separate; V8's public mission completed seven canonical calls and its conversation retained a partial actual execution.
gaps.remaining: Those dated executions establish only their observed availability. V9 availability and complete workflows were observed separately, but quality failed; availability is not continuing reliability.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: The fail-closed runtime manifest now inventories route callers, integrations, prompt/schema versions and bounded roles.
gaps.remaining: It is reviewed configuration rather than automatic call-graph discovery.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Exact request ceilings, token accounting, cooperative cancellation and no automatic billed retry are implemented; the retained ledger counts all 55 actual requests while the application daily ceiling remains 48.
gaps.remaining: No dated-price USD cap, strict mid-transport abort, or completed deployment-wide midnight accounting proof exists.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: A typed harvest forecast and shared reference builder expose marketable mass with batch/date/endpoint/origin/value status and units.
gaps.remaining: Frozen older records remain unchanged and are interpreted conservatively.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: The product now states the actual sequence: six independent specialists followed by a chair that receives bounded validated and rejected findings. The malformed blank-table break in the audit register is removed.
gaps.remaining: No two-round challenge protocol exists and no evidence shows it would improve usefulness.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: One RESPONSE_LIMITS contract drives schema and prompt bounds, with exact-boundary and one-over tests.
gaps.remaining: Sentence count remains nonbinding guidance.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Later-role projections include bounded validation issue codes/messages, evidence state and eligibility; rejected turns cannot become validated evidence.
gaps.remaining: Provider compliance with instructions is not assumed; the local gate remains authoritative.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: New completions persist prompt, schema, validator, numerical/context and source versions plus a public-context hash.
gaps.remaining: Private provider reasoning is intentionally neither persisted nor reconstructed.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Execution, evidence and decision-influence states are separate for missions and conversations, including all-unsupported successful transport.
gaps.remaining: The legacy validation_status field remains only as a compatibility alias.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Registry coverage is derived from validated inputs and contradictory manifest totals fail; archived reports remain dated artifacts.
gaps.remaining: This validates registry accounting, not crop coefficients.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Integrated coverage checks derive expected catalogue size and distinguish knowledge profiles from planner recipes.
gaps.remaining: Only four crops currently have planner recipes.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Versioned numerical-report generation preserves fixture, cohort, settings, cutoff, model and synthetic-only metadata and checks regeneration.
gaps.remaining: Time-limited CP-SAT objective/bounds can vary and are disclosed.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: A licensed project-authored offline provider-contract fixture is byte-hashed and reproduces the current offline pipeline.
gaps.remaining: The ignored historical public response bodies remain an archive and cannot be reconstructed exactly from Git.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Public context is excluded from numerical features and every crop/model artifact remains synthetic/demo-only with production promotion blocked.
gaps.remaining: Real coefficient validity remains unevaluated by design.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Clean-checkout tests use bounded explicit source fixtures or typed missing-source state and do not require a network fetch.
gaps.remaining: Live-source checks remain separate and date-specific.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Versioned tenant-owned synthetic worlds now advance a civil-date clock, record tasks/order service/inventory/cash, replan future work and replay idempotently.
gaps.remaining: Execution remains synthetic and cannot operate a farm.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Provider and numerical work use independent worker lanes; a blocked provider job no longer blocks another tenant local calculation.
gaps.remaining: Each lane is still bounded single-process capacity, not a distributed queue.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Mission requests and acceptance records persist explicit required/advisory Council policy, with missing/partial Council outcomes handled accordingly.
gaps.remaining: No Council outcome itself authorizes real operations.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: The implemented topology is now represented truthfully as sequential specialist reviews plus chair synthesis with explicit visibility.
gaps.remaining: Challenge rounds were not implemented and comparative usefulness is unmeasured.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Research challenges retain history, revalidate on changed inputs, and action retries return the original revision response.
gaps.remaining: The workflow remains scripted unless an explicit separate advisor request is made.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: A shared browser mutation transport persists edition/path/body-bound keys before submission; imports and other mutations have backend receipts.
gaps.remaining: Session storage is browser-session scoped rather than cross-device synchronization.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Conversation transport completion and evidence validity are distinct; V8 retained its direct reply, successful invited turn and terminal partial failure without treating reference validation as prose quality.
gaps.remaining: V8 and V9 answer-quality trials failed; the distinct V10 targeted correction requires its own evidence.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Failed/cancelled immutable scenarios can retry with the original run key, bounded attempt history and atomic no-duplicate accounting.
gaps.remaining: Retries remain local numerical recomputation only.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: V8 is published from its pinned source/image; all eight edition health checks, captured v1–v7 preservation and bounded v7/v8 capacity checks passed.
gaps.remaining: Development upgrades still lack a general per-object runner registry; broader recovery and sustained-capacity evidence remain open.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Council research retains append-only revision history beyond bounded current message/event projections and returns original action receipts.
gaps.remaining: The current view remains intentionally bounded.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Scenario and conversation admission/listing now enforce tenant quotas and bounded cursor queries before expensive work.
gaps.remaining: Explicit bounded retention mechanism is implemented and tested; operator scheduling, backup-retention alignment and deletion-request procedures remain unestablished.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Scenario, conversation and research cancellation endpoints and safe-boundary checks prevent stale acceptance/new provider turns and reconcile unused reservations.
gaps.remaining: An active CP-SAT call and synchronous provider transport are cooperative rather than immediately preemptible.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Main disruption replans accept bounded batch ID, delay, yield and input version, reject stale/unknown input and preserve parent provenance.
gaps.remaining: The supported disruption remains one synthetic crop-delay/yield action, not a general observation model.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Automatic selection persists a deterministic Balanced/service/margin/ID ranking independent of input list order.
gaps.remaining: The ranking is a declared development policy, not a learned preference.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Planner and scenario impacts now expose exact demand-line and lot-to-order allocations with expiry, delivery and shortfall conservation.
gaps.remaining: Buyer, grade and contractual priority remain outside the current schema.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Mission identity and pending mutation state survive reload in edition-scoped browser storage; current hashes/revisions refresh backend truth.
gaps.remaining: Derived navigation/persona/sound state is still local and does not synchronize across devices or durably acknowledge sound.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Cancelling a terminal mission returns its actual status, cancelled=false and an explicit already_terminal reason without mutation.
gaps.remaining: Active cancellation remains cooperative.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Offline conversation and data tests use explicit bounded source fixtures or typed unavailable states; clean-checkout behavior no longer depends on ignored D04 cache.
gaps.remaining: Live public-source freshness is evaluated separately.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: One schedule-state contract distinguishes nursery, growing, ready, recorded harvest, sanitation and availability across backend, UI and execution.
gaps.remaining: Elapsed schedule progress is not physiological growth.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: The UI and planner use the same inclusive horizon ending at planning_date + horizon_days - 1 for 7, 56 and 84 days.
gaps.remaining: No dates beyond the frozen horizon are inferred.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Scenario weights are validated, normalized to integer units and consumed by the objective; constructed tests show weight-sensitive choice and provenance.
gaps.remaining: No stochastic draws or calibrated scenario probabilities are claimed.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Objective terms/units are explicit and Resilient performs lexicographic maximin fill before weighted utility when the primary solve is proven optimal.
gaps.remaining: Time-limited solver metadata does not claim a global proof.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Solver expiry buckets and deterministic FEFO/FIFO replay share earliest-expiry behavior; tiny enumerated perishability regressions reconcile selection and replay.
gaps.remaining: The proof applies only to the registered supported domain.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Closing lots remain explicit physical terminal inventory with zero salvage and a separate policy penalty; they are not mislabeled as waste.
gaps.remaining: No empirical terminal price or general salvage model exists.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Missing price has an explicit state and creates no revenue; booked/residual/order delivery and lot attribution are separate.
gaps.remaining: Buyer, grade and contractual-priority allocation requires future schema expansion.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Independent typed synthetic whole-batch outcomes, temporal/external-style splits, baseline evaluation and hard promotion blocks are implemented; a real-outcome protocol is preregistered.
gaps.remaining: No authorized observed farm outcomes or fitted production biology model exist.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: Synthetic rolling-origin 1/2/4-week farm/buyer evaluation includes cancellations, availability checks, baselines and bootstrap intervals; real evaluation is preregistered.
gaps.remaining: No authorized real-order holdout or calibrated demand distribution exists.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: A machine-readable registry now enumerates implemented constraints, bounds, unsupported capabilities and the contract/validator/solver/replay/UI work needed for each expansion.
gaps.remaining: Water, energy, HVAC, consumables, grade, rotation, multi-cut, partner supply and richer buyer/logistics constraints remain unsupported.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: A local isolated PostgreSQL dump/restore preserved hashes/counts; public V8 health, prior-edition preservation and bounded v7/v8 capacity checks passed.
gaps.remaining: OS/network egress, Fly snapshot restore, multi-host failover, sustained availability and recovery objectives remain unproven.

gaps.current_v8_disposition: A novice/practitioner task study is preregistered with fixed tasks, outcomes, thresholds, coding and privacy handling.
gaps.remaining: No participants have been enrolled; human usability and agronomic benefit remain unknown.
